title: an-approved-proofs-only-build-crosses-proved-on-his-word
intention: When a ticket's build wrote only its own proofs, so the hollow can revert nothing, Akien's answered approval of that proof change is the measurement: the tester records it as the hollow reading (asking him when no answer exists), and clearance accepts that recorded approval at PROVED, while every other empty hollow stays red.
why: Measured 2026-10-06: 45c168cc1ff1's build wrote only its two proofs, so its hollow skipped both as the instrument and sealed {} (0 measured), and clearance refuses hollow_nothing_measured forever: no repair of the code can give it something to revert. Akien already approved that proof change (open-728473f9b70d). The lived symptom: a ticket he said yes to cannot cross PROVED, and the only ways past are faking writes_to or weakening the gate. Ruling 8p (2026-10-06): his approval is the measurement; the tester asks for it and records it, and clearance accepts the recorded proving.
traces_to: Law 10 (EVERY RECORDED OBSERVATION IS MEASUREMENT: 'Akien said X' is one), Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass; the approval is recorded, not assumed), Law 9 (the measurement-settled vs what only his head can settle: a proof's claim changing is his), CP4 via 'the laws are to serve us'.
how: Two children, one per component boundary (RULE 1). (T) cairn/devices/tester: hollow.measure, when nothing was measured and every skipped file is SKIP_INSTRUMENT, reads the questions bound to the ticket through cairn.tools.question's public interface; a question answered by Akien whose text names one of those files is recorded as {"approved": <qid>} on each such file and the run is green. With none, the run stays red ('measured nothing') and `cairn test --hollow --seal` opens one question to Akien naming the files, once. (C) cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py hollow_lacks: a file read {"approved": <qid>} is covered only when that question resolves, is bound to this ticket and was answered by Akien; anything else is a new lack hollow_approval_unresolved. An empty reading stays hollow_nothing_measured. Then 45c168cc1ff1's hollow is retaken: open-728473f9b70d names its proof, and 45c1 crosses PROVED.
falsifier: RED if after the builds (1) a scratch ticket whose build wrote only its instrument, with an Akien-answered question bound to it naming that file, still measures nothing / reads red at clearance; (2) the same with the question answered by someone else, unresolved, bound to another ticket, or naming none of the files reads green; (3) an empty reading, or a reading whose skips are not all instrument skips, reads green; (4) 763379e32e3b's tooth 3, test_hollow.py, or the standing clearance proofs go red. Horizon: 45c168cc1ff1's hollow retaken records open-728473f9b70d and 45c1 crosses PROVED through harbor clear(). WRONG INTENT if Akien reads an approval recorded this way as one he did not give.
watchme: none, because the standing measurement is the hollow of ticket 45c168cc1ff1 retaken at PROVEME and read through cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py (f5bba1daa72a and ec4ca415f43d carry the teeth)
children: f5bba1daa72a — tester: records an approved proofs-only build, asks once
ec4ca415f43d — clearance: accepts a recorded approval only on re-read
decision_lines: D1 (8p, Akien 2026-10-06, via peer akiendelllinux_cc_0): when a build's hollow can measure nothing because every writes_to file is the ticket's own proof, the tester asks Akien; his approval is the measurement (Law 10), recorded as the proving, and clearance accepts it.
D2 (8p refinement 1, agreed): the question belongs at ticketing (8i); the tester asks at measurement time only when none was answered.
D3 (8p refinement 2, agreed): open-728473f9b70d is 45c168cc1ff1's yes; the tester records it as 45c1's proving.
D4: an empty hollow for any other reason stays hollow_nothing_measured and red; 763379e32e3b tooth 3 narrows to 'proofs-only without a recorded approval stays red', cleared by 8p itself.
